STAGE: idea selection for round_langgraph_trial_20261104 / ideation_1
GOAL: pick one in-scope coupling of a training-only behaviour signal with an explicit negative-curvature operator for RQ-VAE Semantic IDs, distinct from the four rejected earlier-round mechanisms.
READ: the round brief, the three prior rounds (poincare-frechet-successor-codebook, CURVCTRL-SID, LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ, behcone-prefix-rq, succboost-geoshift, BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ, BRad-RQ, TSG-SID), and the scope contract clauses 1-5.
OBSERVED: every rejected mechanism moves or weights the CODEBOOK POINTS (Frechet averaging, radial placement by entropy, per-level curvature, cone constraints, geodesic shift) or reweights the assignment. None of them changes the DISTANCE FORM itself.
REASONING: the unoccupied coupling position is the metric. Put the behaviour factor inside the Poincare distance used for RQ assignment and reconstruction, as a bounded anisotropic warp: D^2 = d_P^2 * (1 + rho_i), rho_i in [0,1] built from the item's successor covariance projected into the latent tangent space. Behaviour-off gives rho=0 (pure Poincare), geometry-off replaces d_P with Euclidean. Bounded warp (factor in [1,2]) means no new free constant needs tuning.
STILL OPEN: nothing blocking; the sign of the warp (+rho = extra resolution along behaviour-varying directions) is argued from rate-allocation, not measured, and is the main risk.

STAGE ideation_1: selection. Read the 3 prior rounds (Frechet-successor codebook, CURVCTRL per-level curvature, LORENTZ profile smoothing, behcone, succboost-geoshift, BRANCHCURV, BRad radial assignment, TSG-SID). All of them relocate or reweight CODEBOOK POINTS / assignment weights. Unoccupied coupling position: the metric itself. Chosen: behaviour-warped Poincare distance D^2 = d_P^2*(1+rho_i), rho_i in [0,1] from a frozen trace-normalised successor covariance, used in RQ assignment and reconstruction. Behaviour-off => rho=0 (pure Poincare); geometry-off => Euclidean base with same rho. Bounded warp removes any tuning knob. Open: sign of the warp is argued from rate allocation, not measured (main risk).

STAGE ideation_1: final answer = IDEA BEHMET-RQ (behaviour-warped Poincare metric inside RQ assignment + reconstruction). Switch flags phi_behavior (V_i:=0) and phi_geometry (Euclidean base) exist in code; only the both-on run is trained, no ablation arm, no sweep, one seed. Derived constants: c=1 fixed, r=round(sqrt(d))=8, add-alpha=1/V, trace-normalised anisotropy budget, clamp rho to [0,1]. Behaviour table frozen from training-split directed transitions only (PPMI -> rank-16 SVD -> per-item rank-8 successor covariance), so no val/test leakage. Marginal cost approx 5-8 percent per step over 72k steps plus a one-off CPU PPMI SVD. Full labelled block is in the response; main risk is that the behaviour basis is misaligned with the latent space so the warp degenerates to isotropic noise.
